alt.en: A hand-coloured engraving of a large brick building around a wide gravel courtyard: two long wings with rows of windows and a central arcaded block with a pediment and clock, under a grey and pink cloudy sky. A few small figures and a dog stand in the courtyard; the title below reads "Foundling Hospital, Guildford Street".
alt.es: Grabado coloreado a mano de un gran edificio de ladrillo en torno a un amplio patio de grava: dos alas largas con hileras de ventanas y un cuerpo central con arcadas, frontón y reloj, bajo un cielo nublado gris y rosado. En el patio hay unas pocas figuras pequeñas y un perro; el título de abajo dice "Foundling Hospital, Guildford Street".

caption.en: The Foundling Hospital, London's home for abandoned babies, in a coloured engraving after Thomas Hosmer Shepherd. From 1750 to the end of his life Handel gave Messiah every spring in its chapel, to raise money for it.
caption.es: El Foundling Hospital, el hogar de Londres para niños abandonados, en un grabado coloreado según Thomas Hosmer Shepherd. Desde 1750 hasta el final de su vida, Händel dirigió el Mesías cada primavera en su capilla para recaudar fondos para él.

source: The Foundling Hospital: the main buildings seen from within the grounds, coloured engraving by J. Henshall after Thomas Hosmer Shepherd
